author: D00ZiE
body: After thinking about the recently demoted staff I had a thought about the "Retired" rank. As of now it is only given to staff members who retire, but I believe it should be given to demoted members as well. Just because they were removed from the staff team it doesn't make what they did as a mod any less helpful towards the server. Although towards the end of their career they were not as active and effective, they were great for the majority of their time as a Moderator. After months of service they at least deserve the satisfaction of having the rank.
